issues.title: Improved `<select>` control for asset lists
issues.body:
Players are complaining about how difficult it is to find assets in the "own force" and "opp force" assets lists.

They would like to be able to search for the asset they need.

The `json-editor` page lists several components that can be used for the `select` control: https://github.com/json-editor/json-editor#optional-requirements

We should find one that works with our snapshot of JSON-editor, and change the template to use it.

I guess these are the requirements
- allow user to start typing asset name, show matching entries
- only allow single selection
- allow for separate array item `value` and `label`.

These are probably the steps:
1. Find working example of third-party select control 
2. Integrate new control into story:
    a. `New Message` - `Land Activity` has a suitable control
    b. Open the above story, and find the `JustLandActivity` story
    c. Find the `Land Activity` template that is used in this story .  It's in `planning-message-templates.mock.ts`.  The select control with separate value and label starts at line `935`.
    d. Push the branch to a PR, so Ian can show the deployed version to the players
3. Ian can then update real templates to use this new control
